note: Art queries for Hermann Hesse's Siddhartha. Wikimedia Commons, PD/CC0 only. Set in the Buddha's India, so the look draws on public-domain Indian and Buddhist art — Raja Ravi Varma's paintings (d.1906), Gandhara and Ajanta Buddhist sculpture and murals, Mughal/Rajput miniatures — plus serene river and water imagery from Japanese woodblock masters (Hiroshige, Hokusai). The fetcher adds 'filetype:bitmap', caps downloads to ~3000px, and retries throttled requests.
